title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once upon a time, there was a small fox. He lived in a big green forest. He was very clever. One day, he felt hungry.

Near the river, he saw a hen with her chicks. The fox wanted to eat them. But the hen was clever too. She said, "Wait! There is a bigger fox behind you." The fox looked back and ran away.

questions.text: What did the fox see near the river?
Why did the fox run away?
options: He believed there was a bigger fox behind him
He was tired and wanted to sleep
He wanted to find a new forest

questions.text: What can we learn about the hen?

vocabulary.definition: able to think and learn quickly
a large area with many trees
a large natural stream of water

paragraph_translations: Bir zamanlar küçük bir tilki vardı. Büyük, yeşil bir ormanda yaşıyordu. Çok zekiydi. Bir gün aç hissetti.
Nehrin yakınında yavrularıyla birlikte bir tavuk gördü. Tilki onları yemek istedi. Ama tavuk da çok zekiydi. Dur! Arkanda daha büyük bir tilki var, dedi. Tilki arkasına baktı ve kaçtı.
